messages:
yara: quick note from onboarding hf/aurora-13b-v2. did static int4 pack (strided-fused) and ran convQA + long-context summary suite. short examples OK but after ~2k tokens we see repeated clauses and factual drift. also kvcache resume looks off when we prepend system prompts.

yara: repro (ded-4):
```bash
./gen_bench --model hf/aurora-13b-v2 --quant static-int4 --prompts tests/long_articles.txt --max-tokens 4096 --warmup 1
```

cheng: did converter run with canonical NFKC? some upstream checkpoints keep zero-widths/soft-hyphen which shift merged BPE ids.

maria: checked mapping: region 12288..12297 contains U+200B variants upstream -> our converter left them intact. that produced an id offset (+1) for several merged tokens which explains boundary-aligned repeats. quick local test: strip U+200B before encode -> repeat rate drops a lot.

devon: kv warmup seems to mask symptoms. running with `--kvmode=warmup` drops loops by ~55% but doesn't eliminate hallucinations. so two orthogonal issues: tokenizer id shift and kv-resume wiring.

cheng: ran `rotary-scan` on projection matrices vs golden. two heads show fractional offsets: head=6 offset=+0.0625 head=14 offset=-0.03125. could be pack byte-alignment or proj-order mismatch during conv.

yara: snippet of converter diff I'm about to push (branch aurora/tokenfix):
```diff
- id 12288 -> token 're-\u200Bjoin'
+ id 12288 -> token 're-join'  # removed zero-width
```
I'll run the pack/re-eval after this. queue ~12m.

maria: if converter fixes majority, we can avoid repacking with per_head_scale tweaks. if not, try rebuilding pack with `per_head_scale=true` to see if quant dequant reduces phase wobble.

devon: i'll dump deterministic step checksums for quick bisect: `python -c "from runner import Model; print(Model('hf/aurora-13b-v2').step_checksum(seed=99,steps=8))"` and post here. low-order byte diffs on proj tensors point to pack alignment issues.

cheng: priority agreed: 1) tokenizer normalization (fast), 2) kv runtime flags/instrumentation (bench), 3) pack rebuild with per-head scales (infra).

triage-bot: Created ticket RH-2601: "aurora-13b int4 onboarding: tokenmap zero-width offsets + kv-resume drift + tiny rotary phase shifts" assigned eng-ml. https://redwood.example/issue/RH-2601 :white_check_mark:

yara: thanks all  will post converter PR + bench logs when done. if anyone sees checksum mismatches for projU/projV please paste them here. :thumbsup:
